run_static_html_test: run the static HTML task test script using mephisto with mock provider and local architect
create_TestScriptConfig: create a TestScriptConfig dataclass that extends RunScriptConfig with defaults for blueprint, architect, and provider
register_script_config: register a script config named scriptconfig with the TestScriptConfig module in the hydra config system
run_main_entry: run the main entry point that loads the DB, creates an Operator, validates config, and waits for runs to finish
load_db_and_process_config: load the database and process the hydra DictConfig for mephisto task operations
